method.action: Recorded native student raw action; action order from saved effective environment configuration, not physical joint_names telemetry.
method.second_order: (a[t]-2*a[t-1]+a[t-2])**2; first two samples zero, matching startup suppression for no-reset episodes
method.aggregation: Sum per joint over window; percentages use ratio of sums, not mean of per-step percentages. Combined = abs(weight_rate)*sum_rate + abs(weight_smooth)*sum_smooth. Multiply by step_dt for reward magnitude. Command transitions retained.
limitations: Offline decomposition of recorded evaluation actions, not new simulation or hardware evidence.
No reward-term telemetry: values reconstructed using saved weights and implemented formulas.
Shares are within these two penalties, not total environment reward or causal contribution to vibration.
Single environment, seed 42; no training exploration actions represented.
